title: Gotrade Daily: Nvidia's AI Rally Meets Jackson Hole
summary: Nvidia's post-earnings AI rally meets the Jackson Hole rate signal tonight. See the watchlist: NVDA, MU, AMD, PYPL, and AFRM for the US session.
body_markdown:
The counterweight is a hawkish tone. US inflation is still 3.4%, above the Fed's target, and the market is pricing roughly one-in-three odds of a September rate hike. All eyes are on the Jackson Hole podium tonight.


## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Post-earnings, rally extends Revenue $96.2B (+106% YoY), Q3 guide $108B. The gauge for whether the AI trade holds.


[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) Lifted by memory sentiment Read-through from an AI memory shortage seen lasting through 2030. MU is the US-listed way to play it.


[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) High beta The AI-chip name that swings hardest on tonight's Jackson Hole tone.


[PYPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/pypl/) Deal premium deflates The Advent and Stripe group dropped its PayPal pursuit (bid above $53B), so the takeover premium fades.


[AFRM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/afrm/) Reported yesterday, record profit Quarterly net income $1.62B, raised guidance, medium-term GMV growth target of 25%+.


## Tonight's Catalysts


### Nvidia earnings afterglow


The Data Center segment contributed about $89 billion of that revenue, and management guided next quarter to $108 billion. The AI-chip rally that followed is the main driver of risk appetite tonight, and how **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** trades will measure whether the momentum lasts.


### Jackson Hole and the rate path


Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first keynote as chair at Jackson Hole tonight. With inflation at 3.4% and the market pricing roughly one-in-three odds of a September hike, a hawkish tone could pressure long-duration stocks such as the tech names. The focus is the Fed's signal on the direction of rates.
